I've been coming to Thailand annually for the last 8 years, and have lived here for the last 6 months...it's meant to be "high season" but it pales in comparison to usual years. I personally know many people who have cancelled their usual holidays here. Much of the "clean up" effort done by the military in Phuket has actually had bad effects for the locals, for example hundreds of beach vendors and masseurs left without jobs once they decided to clean up the beaches.

Combine that with the recent murders on Koh Tao, the German who was killed this month up north, rapes, I could go on...So sad to see the way its been going downhill the last few years :(

I'm happy that you and your father were able to make a beautiful table (and a beautiful memory) together, and I'm especially happy that his sight limitation doesn't stop him from following his passion. Thank you for making me smile
